articles.summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, today announced Intake, a front door for in-house legal teams with the Legora Agent at its core, available now in Slack. Intake turns everyday legal requests into tracked work in Legora and can prepare it using the legal team’s own Skills and playbooks, so lawyers review a first draft rather than start from a blank page.
